- **Notifications settings follow Android:** Settings › Notifications checks Android's notification setting again when you come back to it, and tells you when notifications are turned off for Forkcast.
- **A more compact portion slider:** in "How much did you eat?", the Custom… button now sits next to the portion and calories, so the slider takes less room on screen.
